ترتعفون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَعِفُونَ (tartaʕifūna) /tar.ta.ʕi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# تُرْتَعَفُونَ (turtaʕafūna) /tur.ta.ʕa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
